items.title: Pay annual electricity statement balance
items.quote: Please pay the balance within 14 days of the statement date.
items.computation: Start event: statement date 20 Nov 2026. Under §187 Abs.1 BGB the day of the triggering event (the statement date) is not counted, so the 14-day period starts on 21 Nov 2026. Counting 14 days: 21-30 Nov (10 days) + 1-4 Dec (4 days) = 14th day on 4 Dec 2026 (Friday). This is a payment to a private company, so holidays of the payer's own Land (NW) would apply if the last day fell on a weekend/holiday (§193 BGB), but 4 Dec 2026 is a regular Friday, so no shift is needed.

items.title: New higher monthly instalment begins
items.quote: Your new monthly instalment from December is €94.00.
items.computation: The letter only states that the new instalment of €94.00 applies 'from December' without naming the specific day each month the instalment is collected/due, so the exact first due date within December cannot be determined from the letter alone.
